plan.summary: PR-2 of the cxapi send-engine split: build WapCrmSendClient — an IHttpClientFactory typed client that POSTs PLAIN TEXT to cxapi /api/chatoperation, parses the WapCrM envelope (status/statusCode/requestID/message), and maps the response to a typed WapCrmSendResult (Submitted / ProviderFailed / RateLimited / Ambiguous / TransportError). Per-request secret via HttpRequestMessage TryAddWithoutValidation('X-CIB-SecretKey') (NEVER DefaultRequestHeaders). 301/302 (HTTP redirect status OR envelope statusCode '301'/'302') = rate limit → bounded internal retry with Retry-After-honoring backoff+jitter, then RateLimited. Registered in Outbound DI but NO prod caller wires it (routing = PR-3). Fake-HttpMessageHandler integration tests prove the contract. Behavior is a NO-OP for every existing send path.
plan.q_intent: PR-2 cxapi paketine basla — WapCrmSendClient (dev asamasi). IHttpClientFactory tabanli, cxapi /chatoperation'a duz-metin gonderim yapabilen typed client + fake/stub entegrasyon testi. HICBIR prod gonderim yolu bu client'a baglanmaz (routing PR-3). Client yazilir, DI'ya kaydedilir, testle dogrulanir, ama MessageSenderService/orchestrator cagirmaz.
plan.interview_notes: Interview (3 gri nokta, AskUserQuestion ile cozuldu 2026-06-06): (1) CLIENT HOME = Invekto.Shared/Contracts/Inma — cxapi'ye giden mevcut analog HttpInmaContactOptOutClient ve envelope/settings DTO'lari (WapCrmApiResponse, WapCrmSettings) zaten orada; izolasyon: Outbound Shared uzerinden cagirir (PR-3 wiring). (2) RATE LIMITER (P0 #6 tenant+instance) = client RateLimited sonucu dondurur, mevcut Outbound RateLimiter'a (tenant-only, canli bridge MessageSenderService kullaniyor) DOKUNULMAZ — no-op korunur, gercek limiter wiring PR-3; client Shared'da oldugu icin zaten Outbound.Services.RateLimiter'a referans veremez (Shared->Outbound bagimliligi yasak), bu da kararla ortusur. (3) 301/302 = bounded internal retry + backoff/jitter -> tukenirse RateLimited (mesaj GONDERILMEDIGI icin guvenli; Codex P0 #2/#6 ile uyumlu: tek guvenli delayed-retry yolu 301/302). DELAY + JITTER injectable (test deterministik, gercek sleep yok). EK KARAR (dev tarafindan, plan-review'da Codex teyidi icin isaretlendi): cxapi'nin 301/302'yi HTTP redirect statusu mu yoksa envelope statusCode'u mu olarak donduregi kilavuzda net degil (kilavuz §5 statusCode'lari uygulama-seviyesi: 509/911/622... ama Codex P0 #6 'Retry-After' diyor=HTTP header). Bu yuzden client HER IKISINI de rate-limit kabul eder (HTTP 301/302 VEYA envelope statusCode '301'/'302') — savunmaci dual-detection. AllowAutoRedirect=FALSE zorunlu (yoksa HttpClient 301/302'yi otomatik takip edip rate-limit sinyalini yutar). PR-2'de YENI runtime/error kodu YOK (cxapi INV kodlari PR-3); client typed enum doner, ErrorCodes'a dokunmaz. TEST evi = mevcut InvektoServis.Tests (Outbound+Shared zaten ref'li, MockHttpMessageHandler + FakeLoggerFactory + FluentAssertions hazir) — yeni csproj/sln wiring yok. Acik INMA sorulari G12/G13 PR-2'yi BLOKLAMAZ (PR-3/4 oncesi). PLAN-REVIEW (codex_consult critique 2026-06-06) sonucu islenen duzeltmeler: (a) PRECEDENCE FIX: envelope status==true OTORITER -> Submitted, statusCode '301'/'302' gorunse bile retry ETME (mesaj kabul edilmis; '{status:true,statusCode:301}' celiskili envelope'unu duplicate'lemekten kacin); envelope-301/302 yalniz status!=true iken rate-limit sayilir. (b) Handler hardening: AllowAutoRedirect=false + UseCookies=false (pooled handler'da cookie ile cross-tenant sizinti onlenir). (c) TryAddWithoutValidation donus degeri kontrol edilir; false ise auth'suz istek gondermek yerine InvalidOperationException. (d) Input validation: secret/phone/text bos -> ArgumentException, instanceId/userId<=0 -> ArgumentOutOfRangeException (fail-fast, secret deger loglanmaz). (e) TransportError 'provably not sent' DEGIL (response fazinda da kopabilir) -> retry-safe varsayilmaz, PR-3 muhafazakar isler; PR-2 client'i sadece 301/302 retry eder. (f) Retry-After typed RetryConditionHeaderValue ile parse (delta-seconds VE HTTP-date). (g) MaxRateLimitRetries configurable (PR-3 limiter ile double-backoff'u onlemek icin 0'a cekilebilir). (h) Secret-isolation testine CONCURRENT (paralel iki secret) senaryosu eklenir. (i) Envelope DTO reuse: mevcut WapCrmApiResponse<T> kullanilir (duplike envelope DTO yok); status alani eksikse default false -> ProviderFailed (guvenli yon, asla yanlis Submitted).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WapCrmSendClient.SendPlainTextAsync builds a /api/chatoperation request with {instanceID, userID, chatPhoneNumber, messageType=1, messageText} and parses the WapCrM envelope into WapCrmSendResult.

Secret is attached PER REQUEST via HttpRequestMessage.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation('X-CIB-SecretKey', secret) (return value checked — false => InvalidOperationException, no unauthenticated send) and NEVER via DefaultRequestHeaders; secret is never logged or stored on the client. Handler sets AllowAutoRedirect=false AND UseCookies=false. Tests: (i) two SEQUENTIAL sends with different secrets and (ii) CONCURRENT parallel sends with different secrets through the same client — each captured request carries its own secret, DefaultRequestHeaders has none, no cross-contamination.

HTTP 2xx + envelope status=true => Submitted (carrying provider statusCode/requestID) and is AUTHORITATIVE — even a contradictory statusCode like '301' does NOT cause a retry once status=true. HTTP 2xx + status!=true (non-rate-limit code) => ProviderFailed. Both are structured results, never thrown exceptions.

Rate limit (HTTP 301/302 transport OR envelope statusCode '301'/'302' WHILE status!=true) triggers bounded internal retry with Retry-After-honoring (delta-seconds or HTTP-date) backoff+jitter; when retries (configurable MaxRateLimitRetries) are exhausted the result is RateLimited (final-fail=false). A 301-then-200 sequence recovers to Submitted. 301/302 is the ONLY retried outcome.

A request timeout (linked-CTS CancelAfter, original ct NOT cancelled) maps to Ambiguous and is NOT retried; an HttpRequestException/unparseable body maps to TransportError. Caller cancellation is rethrown.

NO-OP: no existing send path changes. Client is registered in Outbound DI (AddHttpClient with AllowAutoRedirect=false) but no endpoint/hosted-service/orchestrator resolves it. Full solution builds clean. No new error codes; no schema/arch change; RateLimiter and MessageSenderService untouched.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: WapCrmSendClient + its request/result/options DTOs live in Invekto.Shared/Contracts/Inma (alongside HttpInmaContactOptOutClient).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Direct analog: Outbound->cxapi.wapcrm.net opt-out push already lives there; WapCrmApiResponse/WapCrmSettings envelope DTOs are already in Contracts/Inma/Dtos. Keeps microservice isolation (Outbound consumes via Shared) and is why the client structurally CANNOT reference Outbound.Services.RateLimiter.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: new client in Shared, consumed by Outbound via DI. This is a Shared change -> full solution build is intentional, not scope creep.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Rate limit is detected as EITHER an HTTP 301/302 response OR an envelope statusCode of '301'/'302' WHILE status != true. Decision precedence: (a) HTTP 301/302 -> rate-limit; (b) parse envelope (fail -> TransportError); (c) HTTP 2xx && status==true -> Submitted (AUTHORITATIVE); (d) statusCode in {'301','302'} -> rate-limit; (e) else -> ProviderFailed. Handler at DI: AllowAutoRedirect=FALSE and UseCookies=FALSE.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: The integration guide documents statusCode values as application-level (509/911/622...) but Codex P0 #6 references an HTTP 'Retry-After' header — the 301/302 transport is genuinely ambiguous in the source docs (open INMA detail). Dual-detection is correct under both interpretations. status==true must win FIRST (plan-review fix): a contradictory '{status:true,statusCode:301}' means the message was accepted, so retrying it would duplicate. AllowAutoRedirect=false or HttpClient silently follows a 301/302 and the rate-limit signal is lost; UseCookies=false stops a pooled handler's shared CookieContainer from carrying state across tenants.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: 301/302 are treated as RATE LIMIT, not real redirects. status==true is authoritative and is checked BEFORE the envelope-301/302 rate-limit branch (no retry on an accepted message). AllowAutoRedirect=false + UseCookies=false are deliberate and required. 307/308 are not auto-followed and fall through to TransportError (undocumented for cxapi).

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Client returns a structured WapCrmSendResult.RateLimited carrying RetryAfter + the (TenantId, InstanceId) it was called with; it does NOT touch the Outbound RateLimiter.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Q decision (interview): the (tenant_id, instance_id) RateLimiter wiring is PR-3. The live RateLimiter is keyed tenant-only and used by the bridge MessageSenderService; changing it would break the no-op guarantee. The client surfaces the cooldown signal so PR-3 can key its limiter on (tenant, instance).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: no RateLimiter change in PR-2. The (tenant,instance) key is echoed on the result for PR-3 to consume; this is intentional deferral, not a missing feature.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Bounded internal retry on 301/302 ONLY. Timeout=Ambiguous (no retry). Other transport/non-2xx/parse failures=TransportError (no retry). 200+status=false=ProviderFailed (no retry). Backoff delay + jitter are injectable seams (default Task.Delay / Random.Shared).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Codex P0 #2: only 301/302 (message provably not sent) is safe to delay-retry; timeout may have reached the server so it is ambiguous and must not auto-retry (duplicate risk). Injectable delay/jitter keeps the integration tests deterministic and instant.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: retry is restricted to the rate-limit path. Ambiguous and ProviderFailed are returned, not retried. Injected no-op delay in tests is a test seam, not dead production config.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: WapCrmSendClient is registered in Outbound DI but intentionally has NO runtime caller in PR-2.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Scope: PR-2 ships and unit-proves the client only; routing (sender route branch, state machine, ext_id) is PR-3. Registering it (AddHttpClient) is behaviorally inert — nothing resolves it during request handling.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: 'registered but unrouted' is by design. MessageSenderService/BroadcastOrchestrator/BulkSendOrchestrator are deliberately untouched (forbidden areas).

verification_questions.question: Is the secret attached per-request (HttpRequestMessage.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation) and never on DefaultRequestHeaders, so two concurrent sends with different tenant secrets through the same pooled HttpClient cannot leak across tenants? Is the secret kept out of all log lines?

Is this PR a true no-op for every existing send path — RateLimiter, MessageSenderService, BroadcastOrchestrator and BulkSendOrchestrator untouched, the new client registered in DI but resolved by nobody during request handling, and no new error codes / schema / canonical .sql changes?

Does the outcome mapping correctly separate retry-safe from unsafe with the right PRECEDENCE: envelope status==true is authoritative Submitted even when statusCode looks like '301' (no duplicate retry); 301/302 (HTTP, or envelope while status!=true) => bounded retry then RateLimited (final-fail=false); timeout => Ambiguous with NO retry; status!=true (non-rate-limit) => ProviderFailed with NO retry; transport/parse failure => TransportError (NOT assumed retry-safe); and are AllowAutoRedirect=false + UseCookies=false set so 301/302 surface and no cookie state crosses tenants?

Do the fake-HttpMessageHandler tests deterministically cover Submitted, status=true-wins-over-301, ProviderFailed (622), RateLimited (HTTP-301 exhausted + envelope-301), 301-then-200 recovery, Ambiguous-timeout, TransportError, and per-request secret isolation (SEQUENTIAL and CONCURRENT) WITHOUT real sleeps (injected no-op delay / zero jitter), asserting the exact /chatoperation request body (instanceID/userID/chatPhoneNumber/messageType=1/messageText) and the per-request secret header while DefaultRequestHeaders stays empty?

WapCrmSendClient: envelope JSON parse guarded (JsonException/null) -> TransportError (no throw to caller)
user_facing_errors: None in PR-2 (no endpoint/route). Client returns a typed WapCrmSendResult; user-facing error-code mapping is PR-3.
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Every branch returns an explicit typed outcome (Submitted/ProviderFailed/RateLimited/Ambiguous/TransportError) — nothing is swallowed. The only intentional 'do nothing further' paths are Ambiguous (no auto-retry to avoid duplicate sends — explicit, logged) and rate-limit-exhausted RateLimited (explicit, carries RetryAfter). The secret is deliberately omitted from logs (security, not a silent failure). No prod path consumes the result yet (PR-3), so there is no place a result could be silently dropped in production.
